correctness.rationale: The full trace includes the zero eigenvalues even after deletion. Differentiating the trace exponential twice in a nonzero symmetric direction K gives t² times an integral of squared Frobenius norms of K sandwiched between invertible exponential factors, hence strict convexity; the hub–leaf entries make the conductance parametrization injective. Compactness and ordinary-leaf symmetry give a unique optimizer on rx+(m−1)y=B with a common y. At y=0 the heat-kernel forms are 2E and (3+E)/2, E=exp(−2tB/r); transferring cost to the ordinary spokes is strictly improving. At x=0, the ordinary component has eigenvalues 0,y,my (multiplicities 1,m−2,1) and the isolated leaf adds a zero. The premium form is A=(m+1+(m−1)exp(−mty))/m from the two zero-mode projections and the hub's my projection. On an ordinary spoke the squared y and my projections are (m−2)/(m−1) and m/(m−1), giving C; the budget derivative is tC(r−A/C). Strict convexity proves deletion iff r≥A/C, including zero derivative at equality. Differentiating in s=exp(−z) gives the negative numerator in RESULT.md line 96 on 0<s≤1. R_m(0)=1 and R_m(z) is asymptotic to (m²−1)exp(z)/(m(m−2)); fixed-z convergence to exp(z) for z>0 brackets the growing-m roots. The positive-spoke reduced matrix, in the basis of the hub, premium leaf and normalized ordinary-leaf sum, has nonzero-eigenvalue sum 2x+my and product (m+1)xy, confirming the formula used for the example. Independently bisecting R_4(z)=3 and minimizing that reduced heat trace gave T=2.00413423245 and x≈0.0519481 at t=3.
residual_risks: The numerical example is corroboration only; the proof is specific to symmetric combinatorial diffusion with one higher-priced spoke, fixed budget equality and disconnected designs admitted.

value.rationale: It gives an exact design rule for when a finite-time mean-square diffusion objective deliberately disconnects a usable vertex. The all-price activation, including the equality and asymptotic scales, distinguishes the criterion from maximizing algebraic connectivity and from the different matching-edge examples. This is a useful active-set classification, not just a spectral calculation for preset weights.
residual_risks: The result does not solve heterogeneous multi-price stars or general graphs.
